# dsh-mt-mcp
### Why this exists
DSH's built-in MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) is configured through the composition: cha
nging the endpoint means editing a profile patch file and restarting the Host. But a phone's LAN IP
**changes** — DHCP lease renewal, a different Wi-Fi, a hotspot.
This plugin moves "where to connect" out of configuration files and into the Web settings page: type
the address, save, and it reconnects. No restart, no YAML.
### What it can do
The tools come from MT; this plugin only forwards them. Three groups by name:
| Prefix | Purpose |
| `mcp__mt__mt_file_*` | Phone files: list directories, search by name/content/size/time, read and w

rite text and bytes, move and delete, create directories |
| `mcp__mt__mt_apk_*` | APK: open a works

pace, analyze manifest/resources/smali/so, edit, rebuild and sign, manage workspaces |
[该节后续省略]
### Security boundary
| Item | Detail |

| Config storage | `~/.dsh/dsh-mt-mcp.json`, mode `0600` |
| Settings routes | `/api/dsh-mt-mcp/*` a
ccepts **loopback requests only** (verified via source IP, Host header, Origin), so nobody else on t

he LAN can change your config |
| Token echo | Always masked; the full token exists only in the conf

ig file above |
| Transport encryption | **None**. MT's MCP service is plain HTTP; trusted LAN only

|
| Where data goes | The phone performs the operation and returns results to the AI tool, which may
forward them to a model service. Only expose files you are willing to hand to them |
### Security review notes
If you are reviewing this plugin before installing, these are the only places it touches the outside
world. Everything else is bookkeeping.
**Outbound network** — there is exactly one destination: the MCP endpoint the user typed into the se
ttings panel (`lib/mcp-http.js`). No telemetry, no analytics, no fixed third-party host, no update p
ings. The only URL literals in `lib/` are `https://mt.cc` in a comment and `http://192.168.1.23:8787
/mcp` as an input placeholder.
**Filesystem** — the only write is the plugin's own config, `~/.dsh/dsh-mt-mcp.json`, created with m
ode `0600` (`lib/index.js`). No other path is written, and nothing is deleted.
**Credentials** — the optional MT bearer token is read from the panel, stored only in that config fi
le, and sent only as an `Authorization` header to the user's configured endpoint. It is never logged
and echoed only masked (`abcd****wxyz`). No `process.env` reads.
**No dynamic code** — no `eval`, `new Function`, `vm`, `child_process`, or shell invocation anywhere
. No crypto-mining or download-and-execute patterns.
**Local routes** — `/api/dsh-mt-mcp/*` refuses any request that is not loopback (source IP, `Host`,
and `Origin` are all checked), so nothing on the LAN can read or rewrite the configuration.
**Third-party code** — none at runtime. `package.json` declares no `dependencies`; the MCP client is
the plugin's own `lib/mcp-http.js`.
### Known limitations

- **Streamable HTTP only.** MT's MCP service is HTTP-based; there is no stdio branch.
- `lib/mcp-htt
p.js` implements only initialize / tools/list / tools/call and tool-change notifications; resources,

prompts, and sampling are not implemented (MT does not offer them).
- Tool descriptions and paramet

er schemas come **verbatim from MT**; this plugin adds no validation.
- Image/audio MCP content bloc

ks keep only a type marker; **their payloads are not retained**.
- A single tool call times out afte

r **180 seconds** (APK rebuilds can be slow, so there is headroom).
- DSH must provide the `tools`,
`systemPrompt`, and `webServer` services.
把手机上的 **MT 管理器**（mt.cc）接进 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**。
MT 管理器自带 MCP 服务：在手机上点一下启动，它就把自己变成一个 **Streamable HTTP** 的 MCP 服务器，对外提供手机文件、APK、ZIP 三类能力。本插件是**电脑这一侧的
客户端** —— 一个 DSH 插件包，把 MT 的工具接进 DSH 会话，并在 DSH 的 Web 设置页提供一个可随时修改地址的面板。
连上之后，MT 的能力以 `mcp__mt__*` 工具出现在会话里，直接用自然语言让 AI 操作手机：

## 踩坑：为什么这个插件没有任何运行时依赖
排查了大半天的坑，值得写下来。
最初的实现直接 `import '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk'`。本地 `link:` 安装时立刻炸：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
原因是 **DSH 加载插件时保留符号链接解析**（`--preserve-symlinks` 语义），而 pnpm 把包依赖放进 `.pnpm` 虚拟店：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
按符号链接真实路径向上找依赖时，SDK 的传递依赖（`zod`、`zod-to-json-schema` 等）不在上一层，于是解析失败。用 `--config.node-linker=hoisted`
平铺能缓解本地 link 场景，但**换成 tarball / git / 插件库安装时布局又不同**，用户装完照样可能失败。
**最终解法：把依赖降到零。** MCP 的 Streamable HTTP 只是「POST JSON-RPC + SSE 响应」，用 Node 内置 `fetch` 一百多行就够，于是有了 `lib
/mcp-http.js`。插件现在只 import DSH 自己提供的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 和 Node 内置模块，任何安装方式都能直接加载，不需要 `pnpm ins
ttp.js`。插件现在只 import DSH 自己提供的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 和 Node 内置模块，任何安装方式都能直接加载，不需要 `pnpm install`。
代价是实现了协议的一小块（initialize / tools/list / tools/call / 通知 + 会话头），不支持 stdio、resources、prompts、sampling。对
initialize / tools/list / tools/call / 通知 + 会话头），不支持 stdio、resources、prompts、sampling。对「连 MT」这个目标够了。
## 已知限制

- **只支持 Streamable HTTP**。MT 的 MCP 服务是 HTTP 型，插件没做 stdio 分支。
- `lib/mcp-http.js` 只实现了 initialize / t

ools/list / tools/call 与工具变更通知；MT 不提供的 resources、prompts、sampling 未实现。
- 工具描述与参数 schema **原样来自 MT**，

本插件不做校验增强。
- 图片/音频类 MCP 内容块只保留类型说明，**内容不落地**。
- 单次工具调用超时 **180 秒**（MT 重打包 APK 可能较慢，留了余量）。
- 需要 DSH 侧
有 `tools` / `systemPrompt` / `webServer` 三个服务。
